input.question: When was the Earle House built?

documents.text: Earle House (Canehill, Arkansas) Earle House is a house in Canehill, Arkansas on Highway 45 built in 1859 to house Dr. Fountain R. Earle, the president of Cane Hill College. The property was added to the National Register of Historic Places along with many other Canehill properties in November 1982. The house, set well back from the highway, is a single-story wood frame structure, with a side gable roof and a projecting gable-roof section on the front (western) facade.
